## Scope and controls

- [ ] The change is focused and coordinated with related open PRs.
- [ ] Source examples are public or synthetic; no secrets, private content or
      incidental generated artifacts are included.
- [ ] Build/security boundaries are preserved: shell escape disabled, pinned
      actions, least privilege and tag-only publication.
- [ ] Documentation and the settings-drift receipt are updated where relevant.

No mandatory human, CODEOWNERS or team approval is required. Checkboxes describe
evidence to review; they do not replace successful automated checks.
